<thought>Only the carbon isotopic pattern (13C) is clearly evident from the significant M+1 peak (~6.7% of the monoisotopic peak) and the smaller M+2 peak consistent with two 13C atoms. No other element shows its characteristic isotopic signature (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
